title: Material found buried deep in rocks at the crash site
summary: Diana Pasulka tells of Material found buried deep in rocks at the crash site, about 2016 at New Mexico (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: we did find things but they weren't easy to find if they were placed there they were placed so far down rocks that had been there for looked like a hundred years

plain: A religion scholar named Diana Pasulka says that in 2016 she went with others to a place in New Mexico said to be a crash site of an unknown craft. She says they did find things, but they were very hard to reach, buried deep in rocks that looked about a hundred years old. If true, that would make it unlikely the material had been planted there recently.
